title: Cults3D - CAO STEP/STL d'un cache-moyeu Porsche 993
notes: La fiche allemande propose quatre fichiers, STEP et STL, en deux variantes : face vierge et logo FF, pour un cache-moyeu associe a la reference OEM 993 361 303 11. La page ne publie ni dimensions, ni instrument, ni scan, ni controle sur roue; la mention de modele pret a imprimer est commerciale. Le fichier et les droits de redistribution doivent etre achetes et verifies avant toute utilisation. Piece liee a la roue : aucune reproduction, modification ou liberation sans mesure sur la roue exacte, controle d'interface et revue d'ingenierie appropriee. 2026-10-15: same asset as SRC-CULTS-993-WHEEL-CENTER-CAP (same Cults URL), whose 2026-08-29 read recorded the Cults private-use licence. Before this pass this record said 'commercial-marketplace-license-not-verified' with redistribution unknown, from its own 2026-08-30 read of the page. It now records the twin's licence, marked as not re-read here, and redistribution prohibited, the more restrictive of the two values, until the page is read again. The 2026-08-29 and 2026-08-30 reads disagree on whether a licence was shown. On 2026-10-15 the Cults page was not read: cults3d.com served its robots.txt behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403), so permission for automated agents could not be established and the page was not requested.
